recipe.title: Roast chicken salad with cucumber, radishes and dill
recipe.intro: Cucumbers are crisp and plentiful by mid May. Paired with warm roast chicken and new potatoes, they make a big salad that still feels like a proper Sunday dinner.
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C fan, 210°C conventional. Zest and juice the lemon and set aside. Rub the chicken with 1 tbsp oil, salt and pepper, push the squeezed lemon halves inside and roast in a tray for 30 minutes.

Toss the potatoes with 1 tbsp oil and a pinch of salt. Tip them around the chicken, turning them in the juices, and roast for 50 minutes more, until the potatoes are golden and the chicken juices run clear.
Meanwhile, put the cucumber in a sieve with a pinch of salt and leave over the sink for 20 minutes. This draws out water so the salad stays crisp.
Stir the yoghurt, lemon zest and juice, most of the dill, the last 1 tbsp oil and some pepper together in a small bowl. Add a splash of water if it is too thick to drizzle.
Lift the chicken out and rest it for 15 minutes. Then pull the meat into chunky pieces, discarding the skin if you like, and spoon over a little of the tray juices.
Spread the lettuce over a large platter. Scatter over the cucumber, radishes, spring onions and warm potatoes, then pile on the chicken.
Drizzle with the dressing, finish with the rest of the dill and bring to the table for everyone to help themselves.
recipe.tip: Simmer the chicken carcass with an onion, a bay leaf and water for an hour or two to make stock for a soup later in the week.
